recommendation_summary: Set up a single heartbeat/dead-man check for nightly-sync that the job pings on success or failure and that alerts the user if no successful ping arrives by morning.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to catch a silent nightly-sync failure without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log on the Synology and moving everything to Docker.
labels.Bottleneck: The success email is sent by the job itself, so a startup crash means silence.
labels.Checked myself: nightly-sync runs at 03:00 on edna, emails on finish, crashed 4 nights on expired token before email, with no other alerting.

note: The reply recommends only one heartbeat alert, explicitly rejects the log server, and all four labelled lines come before the recommendation and stick to facts from the situation.
